verdict.rationale: The evidence describes the dLocal API, Smart Fields, an MCP server and LLM-friendly docs, but none of it documents official client SDKs or language libraries to build against. The MCP server, Markdown docs and llms.txt are adjacent AI tooling, not SDKs. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404, so there is no spec-based SDK generation path evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
